description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the SplitVideoParts operation for video splitting
description_zh: 本文介绍视频拆条SplitVideoParts的语法及示例
name: SplitVideoParts

parameters.help_en: The URL of the video. We recommend that you use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the China (Shanghai) region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 视频URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The splitting template. Currently, only the `live` template is supported
parameters.help_zh: 拆条模板，当前只支持`live`模板
parameters.name: template

parameters.help_en:
The minimum length of a split segment, in seconds. Configure this parameter based on your business requirements, or leave it empty.
This parameter takes effect only on the SplitVideoPartResults (topic-based splitting) results and does not affect the Elements (shot transition-based) results
parameters.help_zh:
拆条最小长度，单位为秒，用户可以根据实际业务需求进行灵活配置，也可以不配置。
该入参的设置，只对拆条结果SplitVideoPartResults（视频主题进行拆条）有效，不影响Elements（视频镜头转场维度）的结果
parameters.name: min_time

parameters.help_en:
The maximum length of a split segment, in seconds. Configure this parameter based on your business requirements, or leave it empty.
This parameter takes effect only on the SplitVideoPartResults (topic-based splitting) results and does not affect the Elements (shot transition-based) results
parameters.help_zh:
拆条最大长度，单位为秒，用户可以根据实际业务需求进行灵活配置，也可以不配置。
该入参的设置，只对拆条结果SplitVideoPartResults（视频主题进行拆条）有效，不影响Elements（视频镜头转场维度）的结果
parameters.name: max_time

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous task is executed successfully, call the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and perform JSON deserialization on the Result field to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

Elements.description_en: The splitting results based on the video shot transition dimension
Elements.description_zh: 针对视频镜头转场维度进行拆条

items.description_en: The splitting results based on the video shot transition dimension
items.description_zh: 针对视频镜头转场维度进行拆条

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the segment. Unit: seconds
BeginTime.description_zh: 该片段的起始时刻，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the segment. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 该片段的结束时刻，单位：秒

Index.description_en: The sequence number of the segment

SplitVideoPartResults.description_en: The splitting results based on the video topic dimension
SplitVideoPartResults.description_zh: 针对视频主题进行拆条

BeginTime.description_en: The start time of the split segment

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the split segment

Theme.description_en: The topic of the split segment
Theme.example: you like to do my work in the world.

Type.description_en: The type of the split segment. For e-commerce live streaming scenarios, only the default value `Live streaming` is returned
Type.description_zh: 拆条类型，电商直播场景暂时只返回默认值`直播`

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous task is submitted
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
